$comment: Rules for generating the master topic database and cross-exam mapping (scripts/build-mapping.mjs). Manual corrections belong in overrides.json, not here.

similarity.method: Minimum pairwise Jaccard overlap of the subtopic sets that each exam includes for the topic (Phase 1 only/exclude). Identical library IDs guarantee the same concept; the overlap measures how much of it each exam covers.

syncModes.full: Fully shared: shared concept learning updates every linked exam, and conceptual progress recorded in any linked exam is written back to the shared record.
syncModes.partial: Partially shared: concept completion is shared (it raises linked exams' completion), but each exam's topic status stays its own and exam status changes are not written back.
syncModes.independent: Independent: no synchronization in either direction.

descriptive.depthDescription: Typed descriptive writing to the exam's format and word limits.

skill.depthDescription: Keyboard skill test: reach the qualifying speed and accuracy standard.

physical.depthDescription: Physical standards / endurance: meet every qualifying standard.

personality.depthDescription: Interview, group exercise or personality assessment preparation.

language-test.depthDescription: Read, write, speak and understand the opted local language.

requirementProfiles.depthDescription: Pass/fail standard; prepare to the qualifying level.
Standard SSC-level questions; accuracy under negative marking.
Advanced, multi-step SSC Tier-II / Paper-II level problems.
Speed-based calculation and pattern recognition at clerk level.
Speed-based questions at PO prelims level (puzzles, DI, arithmetic under a 20-minute section timer).
Complex applications, caselets and DI-linked calculations at PO mains level.

requirementBasis.speedTargetSec: official-section-pace: section duration ÷ section questions from the official notification (stage pace when the section has no own timer).
requirementBasis.difficulty: editorial-estimate by exam category, stage and level.
requirementBasis.depth: editorial-estimate by exam category, stage and level; topic-specific descriptions from overrides.json.
